description: A 1.x policy preserves the documented lenient legacy ETH path when the SIGIL_EVM_AMOUNT_REQUIRED deployment flag is unset: a missing amount skips max_transaction_eth and consensus_threshold_eth. The engine-side fail-closed erratum applies to these policies only behind the flag.
policy:
version: 1.0.0

## evm
max_transaction_eth: 2.0
allowed_actions: wallet.transfer, contract.call
allowed_chains: 1
consensus_threshold_eth: 1.0
consensus_require_hold: true
